articleTitle: Automation of water meter testing using stepper motors
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: This paper presents an application of a water meter "Tester" made with the help of a stepper motor control module, a functional mechanical part of a water meter and other tools created for testing. The testing steps, along with the architecture of the tester and the water meter will be explained. The achievement of this electronic water meter adapter testing application is the simulation of water flow through the mechanical water meter using a stepper motor.

articleTitle: Object classification using frequency analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: This article presents a method that allows object classification based on the sound resonance of their material and artificial intelligence. For this purpose, multiple Artificial Intelligence algorithms and sound processing methods will be considered. The final objective of this research is to obtain an Artificial Intelligence model that can be used in industrial and non-industrial activities with the purpose of automation.

articleTitle: Security System with High Autonomy of Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: The present work aims to achieve a home security system with low energy consumption and high autonomy of operation. The system can transmit information about his status on long distanced in real time through a GSM network. The system has been designed in such a way that it does not interrupt its operation for at least five days if the main wall electricity source to which it is connected suffers a breakdown. The proposed solution implies to power up the system from an external rechargeable energy source (external battery), so the system will have an energy reserve that will extend its operation time. In order to offer as much autonomy as possible, we opted for the use of a secondary source for charging the external battery. In this direction we considered the solar energy as the most suitable for this application. More precisely, the use of a small photovoltaic panel that will supplement the external battery with electricity during the day and will thus increase the autonomy of the system.

articleTitle: A practical implementation for an instrument to measure displacement of pendulum wire
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: An optical measuring device was developed in order to measure pendulum displacement in dam monitoring. A low cost solution was sought while maintaining the accuracy of the instrument at the current standards. The selection of the components, the assembly and the functioning of the instrument are explained. The results of the measurements are discussed.

articleTitle: Correlating electrical and process parameters for yield detractors’ detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: The yield is considered a key performance measure in determining the success of semiconductor manufacturing. As the inherent process variation affects the yield and causes redesign, quick and accurate methods are needed for yield analysis and failure root cause discovery in a cost- and time-efficient way. The paper proposes a method for yield detractors' identification, by investigating the correlation information of electrical parameters and process parameters. The method bridges the gap between design and manufacturing and it gains an enhanced understanding and subsequent approach for yield improvement.

articleTitle: Cross-Correlation Based Automatic Segmentation of Medial Phonemes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: This paper describes a cross-correlation based method aimed at extracting homogeneously-trimmed target medial phonemes from a reference pronunciation (a word or logatome pronounced by the Speech Language Pathologist (SLP)) and a sample utterance (the same word/logatome pronounced by a subject). The newly-generated audio segments are then fed to an Information Entropy based classification stage in order to assess the (dis)similarities between them and to serve as a valid, automated Speech Sound Disorder (SSD) Screening tool. The input for the study consisted in audio recordings of a Romanian word containing the target phoneme /r/ in medial position pronounced by a population of 44 preschoolers and primary schoolers, aged 6-7.

articleTitle: Fourth-Order Buck-Boost Converters Exhibiting Minimum Phase by Reverse Inductor Coupling
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: Three fourth-order buck-boost converters with improved dynamic response are proposed. The improved dynamic response is achieved starting from the uncoupled inductors topologies and performing reverse coupling. This leads to the shift of the right half plane (RHP) zeros to the left half plane (LHP). The state-space small signal model is developed and the control-to-output transfer functions are derived. A comparison is made to the uncoupled and direct coupled topologies revealing the RHP zeros elimination. The simulations confirm that also with reverse coupling the input and output currents still maintain their smooth nature.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of sub-band MVDR beamforming for IEEE 802.11ac wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to implement, simulate and evaluate the sub-band MVDR (Minimum Variance Distortionless Response) algorithm for IEEE 802.11ac signals of different bandwidths. Its implementation and evaluation were performed using Matlab. The algorithm proved to have a good performance and be suitable for directing the main lobe of the antenna array radiation pattern in the desired direction. Moreover, an improvement in the data transmission quality was proven, as the BER (bit error rate) indicator show-cased lower values in the same SNR conditions as the non-beamforming scenario.

articleTitle: EMC Characteristics of Helical Antennas used in Automotive Testing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: Radiated immunity (RI) testing is gaining momentum due to current tendency of increasing presence of complex electronic systems inside cars. Meaningful RI testing results are crucial for driving safety. However, testing equipment is prone to parameter modification because of aging and overuse. In this paper, measurements on NMHA antennas and connectors used in RI testing in the frequency range between 26 MHz and 360 MHz are reported and compared to producers' data and solutions for improving reliability of the tests in a real EMC laboratory context are proposed and assessed.

articleTitle: A Forensics System for Live-Audio Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: A common problem in audio forensics is the difficulty to authenticate an audio recording. You can have an argument against any audio probe. In this paper we propose a system that can take audio probes which can be used with success in a court. The recording will be bulletproof due to the use of a reference protocol based on an external entity, the company that provides the recording system. Using an external cloud-based application, for the recorded person and for the recording institution, the resulted audio-recording will be 100% authenticated in terms of integrity check. All editing by means of deleting/inserting audio fragment longer than 5 ms will be detected.

articleTitle: Parameter Monitoring and Logging of a Thermo- Electric Hybrid Solar System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Electronics and Telecommunications (ISETC)
abstract: This work presents the monitoring and logging of parameters of a solar system. The solar system is used to generate current and heat up water. Gathering and monitoring data can be always beneficial to any system, since upon a failure, an immediate remedy can be done. If using a reaction loop, it can react if the parameters of the system are out of limits. The presented system has 23 parameters monitored, like temperatures, pressures, flows and irradiance. There are 8 sensors systems; some of them can measure up to 4 temperatures. Most of the sensors are connected via RS-485 industrial serial bus.
